reasoning_content: The system module in Drupal 11.3 no longer creates a `system` table for module enablement—it must be using a different approach now. I need to figure out how ModuleHandler is determining which modules are enabled in this version.

action.command:
cd /workspace
grep -rn "getAll\|function load\|module handler\|enabled" web/core/lib/Drupal/Core/Extension/ModuleHandler.php | head -20; echo "==="; grep -rn "class ModuleHandler" -A 30 web/core/lib/Drupal/Core/Extension/ModuleHandler.php | grep -n "module_handler\|cache\|storage" | head

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "cd /workspace\ngrep -rn \"getAll\\|function load\\|module handler\\|enabled\" web/core/lib/Drupal/Core/Extension/ModuleHandler.php | head -20; echo \"===\"; grep -rn \"class ModuleHandler\" -A 30 web/core/lib/Drupal/Core/Extension/ModuleHandler.php | grep -n \"module_handler\\|cache\\|storage\" | head", "security_risk": "LOW", "summary": "Find how ModuleHandler loads enabled modules"}

summary: Find how ModuleHandler loads enabled modules
